title: Next.js 16.4 makes caching more explicit as OpenAI launches Decisions API
summary: Two October 6 releases give developers more control over what gets rendered ahead of time and what an AI endpoint is allowed to return.
imageAlt: Illustration of a cached browser page connected to three bounded decision paths
imageCaption: Original illustration of static page rendering and typed AI decisions; not a product screenshot.

sections.heading: Cache Components become the starting point for new Next.js apps
paragraphs: Next.js 16.4, announced October 6, enables Cache Components by default in newly created `create-next-app` projects. The model lets developers mark parts of a component tree with `'use cache'` while other parts can still render for a request. The Next.js team now recommends this approach for new apps, but says it is planned to become the framework-wide default in Next.js 17—not in every existing 16.4 app.

Existing projects must choose to adopt it. The release post shows both `cacheComponents: true` and `partialPrefetching: true` in the configuration. An upgrade alone does not silently convert an application's rendering and caching behavior.

sections.heading: Static routes can fail early instead of becoming dynamic by accident
paragraphs: The new `ensureStatic` setting can require a route's shell, prefetch, or full navigation to stay static. At its strictest `navigation` level, adding request-time content makes the build fail. This is useful for pages whose deployment cost or response time depends on avoiding unexpected server rendering; it does not make a dynamic page static automatically.

Next.js 16.4 also adds `navigation()` and `prefetch()` controls for deciding which cached work waits until a real visit or an explicit prefetch. Those choices let teams avoid fetching every part of a page merely because a link became visible. They still need to decide which content is worth loading early for their own users.

sections.heading: OpenAI gives classification a narrower endpoint
paragraphs: OpenAI's October 6 API changelog introduced the Decisions API in public beta. It accepts text, images, or both through `POST /v1/decisions`, currently using only `gpt-6-luna`. Rather than generating an open-ended reply, a question requests one of three typed results: an estimated probability for a condition, a choice from supplied options, or a score against ordered levels.

The official guide positions these answers for tasks such as classifying content, routing requests, and prioritizing work. Independent questions can share a request; if a later decision depends on an earlier answer, it needs a separate request. This makes the endpoint a focused option for bounded application decisions, not a replacement for every generative workflow.

sections.heading: A faster answer still needs a review threshold
paragraphs: OpenAI describes typed Decisions answers as about ten times faster than its Responses API. That is the company's comparison, not a performance guarantee for every application. The API remains a beta with one supported model, and an individual question can return a refusal instead of the requested result.

For routing or review, the guide recommends setting thresholds with labeled examples and weighing the costs of false positives and false negatives. Teams evaluating image inputs should also note a current integration limit: images must be supplied as inline base64 data URLs, not hosted image links or file IDs.

zh-TW.title: Next.js 16.4 明確控管快取，OpenAI 推出 Decisions API
zh-TW.summary: 10 月 6 日的兩項更新，分別讓開發者更清楚地決定頁面何時渲染，以及 AI 端點能回傳哪一種答案。
zh-TW.imageAlt: 已快取的瀏覽器頁面連接三條限定決策路徑的插畫
zh-TW.imageCaption: 本站原創插畫，呈現靜態頁面渲染與結構化 AI 決策，非產品截圖。

sections.heading: 新建 Next.js 專案預設使用 Cache Components
paragraphs: Next.js 在 10 月 6 日發布 16.4 版；從這個版本起，新建立的 `create-next-app` 專案會預設啟用 Cache Components。開發者可用 `'use cache'` 指定元件樹中哪些部分適合快取，其餘內容仍可依請求即時渲染。團隊現在建議新專案採用這套模式，但表示要到 Next.js 17 才計畫讓它成為整體框架的預設；並不是所有升級到 16.4 的既有網站都會自動切換。
既有專案需要自行選用。官方公告的設定範例同時開啟 `cacheComponents: true` 與 `partialPrefetching: true`。單純升級套件，不會默默改寫現有應用的渲染與快取行為。

sections.heading: 意外變成動態頁面時，可以提早讓建置失敗
paragraphs: 新版的 `ensureStatic` 可以要求路由的 shell、預取內容或完整導覽維持靜態。在最嚴格的 `navigation` 設定下，若加入必須在請求時渲染的內容，建置就會失敗。對仰賴靜態輸出控制伺服器成本或回應時間的頁面，這是明確的保護；它不會自動把原本的動態頁面轉成靜態。
16.4 也加入 `navigation()` 與 `prefetch()`，讓開發者選擇哪些快取工作延後到真正進入頁面、或明確預取時才執行。這可避免連結一出現在畫面上，就先載入目標頁面的所有內容；哪些資料值得提前載入，仍需依網站的使用情境決定。

sections.heading: OpenAI 為分類工作提供範圍更明確的端點
paragraphs: OpenAI 在 10 月 6 日的 API 更新紀錄中推出 Decisions API 公開測試版。它透過 `POST /v1/decisions` 接收文字、圖片或兩者組合，目前僅支援 `gpt-6-luna`。問題不要求自由生成一段文字，而是指定三種結構化結果之一：條件成立的估計機率、從提供的選項中擇一，或依序列等級給出分數。
官方指南將它定位在內容分類、請求分流與工作排序等任務。彼此獨立的問題可放在同一個請求中；若下一步決策要依賴前一步答案，就必須另送請求。因此，它比較適合範圍明確的應用程式判斷，並不能取代所有生成式工作流程。

sections.heading: 回應再快，也需要訂出人工審查門檻
paragraphs: OpenAI 表示，Decisions API 的結構化答案比 Responses API 約快十倍。這是廠商自己的比較，不能當成每個應用場景都會達到的效能保證。此功能仍在公開測試，只有一個支援模型；單一問題也可能回傳拒絕，而不是預期的答案。
若要用它分流或決定是否送人工審查，官方建議先用已標記的範例設定門檻，並衡量誤判為真與誤判為假的成本。評估圖片輸入時還有一項整合限制：目前必須提供內嵌的 base64 data URL，不能直接傳入託管圖片連結或檔案 ID。
